items.title: Skitch Henderson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Milford, Connecticut, October 31, 1998
items.q: But at that time Tiomkin came in and did a film score at Carnegie with something like — I’ll be kind, I think it was like a hundred and five men.

ctx.x: Yeah. I was just going ask about that.
